PC06-002.name: The Reliable Partners
PC06-002.effect:
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "Top Buddy, Aibou", this card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and becomes Cost 5.

[Flash]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, for each Contract Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 25000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. When this effect destroys, if it's the Attack Step, you can either summon one of your "Top Buddy, Aibou" that is in Soul State/pre-advent condition, or [Advent] a Red "Sieg" from your Hand.

PC06-001.name: The Six Pyroxenes
PC06-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send two cores from your Trash to one of your Spirits with "Awaken"-named effects. When you've done so, (Once per Turn: Same Name) including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Top Buddy, Aibou", you can draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Including being in pre-advent condition, while you control any "Top Buddy, Aibou", the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
